moments.author: Jensen Huang
moments.quote: I was unfaithful to my wife… There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.
moments.why: A seismic moment as one of tech’s most powerful CEOs admits infidelity amid a national-security probe, dominating conversation among men 25–45.

moments.author: Jensen Huang
moments.quote: To my wife and family: I love you… I hope our family will heal and that, over time, I can earn back your trust.
moments.why: His personal apology humanizes the scandal and amplifies its cultural and emotional impact.

moments.author: Donald Trump
moments.quote: He’s an honorable guy… probably has an excuse for his infidelity.
moments.why: Trump weighs in with an excusing tone, fueling polarized reactions among political circles.

moments.author: CCnote_
moments.quote: Jensen getting wild with a Chinese woman wasn’t on my bingo card.
moments.why: Witty meme-like commentary that quickly went viral among younger male audiences reacting to the scandal.

moments.author: Watcher.Guru
moments.quote: Jensen Huang… 'I was unfaithful to my wife…' 'I am fully committed to NVIDIA…'
moments.why: Sharp summary tweet-like post that drove widespread engagement around the unfolding investigation.
